[qm] This Claude Code session (u1) is not linked to a work item. Project baseline from cwd: No project.

Open work items:
- alpha — Alpha (demo, feat/a, in_progress)
- beta — Beta (No project, fridge)

Linking protocol — link once the session's purpose is clear from the first message or two, and re-link the moment its work moves to a different item (attach and new both move the session):
- Continues one of the items above → qm attach <slug> --session u1
- Substantial new work → qm new "Title" --project "No project" --session u1 --description "..." — but sanity-check the project against the topic first; if it seems wrong, ask the user instead of guessing.
- Trivial or throwaway (quick question, one-off lookup) → do nothing, and don't mention any of this.
After linking, keep the work item current: qm note <slug> "..." at meaningful milestones.
